sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,os,sys
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
marker=(root/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip()
p=subprocess.run([str(root/'.venv/bin/python'),str(root/'scripts/leads_operational_report.py'),'--checkout',str(root),'--expected-source',marker,'--vault',str(vault),'--with-pm2'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'})
print('OPERATIONAL_REPORT_EXIT',p.returncode)
assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr[-300:]
d=json.loads(p.stdout)
print('RUNTIME_STATUS',d.get('status'))
print('RUNTIME_PM2',json.dumps({k:d.get('pm2',{}).get(k) for k in ('status','restart_count')},sort_keys=True))
print('MODEL_REPORT',json.dumps(d.get('organic_growth_model'),sort_keys=True))
print('READINESS',json.dumps(d.get('readiness_indicators',[]),sort_keys=True))
print('SUPERVISOR',json.dumps({k:d.get('supervisor',{}).get(k) for k in ('status','event_kind','age_seconds','join_request_status','approvals_in_last_cycle','owned_promotion_status')},sort_keys=True))
print('MEMBERS_ADDED',d.get('members_added'),'APPROVAL_COUNT_UNKNOWN',d.get('operation_state',{}).get('status'))
print('MODEL_PRIVATE',vault.joinpath('growth_model.json').is_file())
assert d.get('pm2',{}).get('status')=='ONLINE','worker_not_online'
assert d.get('source',{}).get('matches_expected') is True
print('POSTFLIGHT_PASS')
PY
